notes: Refined core logic to include caching and rate-limit handling without adding new stories.

change_log.value: Implement logic to call Google Routes API to compute distance and travel time from user location to each clinical trial site, including batching, response caching to reduce duplicate calls, rate-limit handling, and graceful error fallback.
change_log.note: Strengthen core logic to address performance and API limits

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define structured schema for trial proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), origin, destination, and fallback indicators when routing fails.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Computation
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Implement logic to call Google Routes API to compute distance and travel time from user location to each clinical trial site, including batching, response caching to reduce duplicate calls, rate-limit handling, and graceful error fallback.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results returned to the chat layer.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Integrate Proximity with Trial Location Extraction
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Ensure proximity calculations are correctly applied to all extracted trial locations, including handling multiple sites per trial and selecting nearest site.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Add tests for distance/time computation, edge cases (missing location, API failure), caching behavior, and end-to-end validation through the facade.
